# Settings store save

Writes a settings store to flash only when the live image differs from the saved bank.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x6005aaaf` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Compares the whole image, updates counter and 16-bit sum, writes flash. Called from the power-down path.
